results.name: THE GRAZER
results.tagline: A bit of everything, nothing touching
results.blurb: You do not want a meal. You want a survey. Nine small portions, arranged with real care, each one tasted and assessed before you commit to a second helping. People think you're indecisive. You are actually conducting research, and the results have been excellent.
results.watchOut: You'll try everything and commit to nothing. Order the one you loved.

results.name: THE PLATE ENGINEER
results.tagline: It's not a portion, it's a structure
results.blurb: You believe in load-bearing carbohydrates. Rice, then curry, then something with gravy, then a strategic piece of bread as a retaining wall. The plate is a small civil engineering project and it has never once collapsed, which you consider a personal achievement.
results.watchOut: More layers is not always more enjoyment. Try a smaller, better plate.

results.name: THE DESSERT FIRST PERSON
results.tagline: Life is short and the cake is right there
results.blurb: You did the maths years ago: the savoury course is a formality and the good part is at the end. So you skipped ahead. You have no interest in pacing yourself, no respect for the order of things, and an entirely justified confidence that you will still have room.
results.watchOut: Sometimes the main is the point. Stay for the whole meal once in a while.

results.name: THE ONE PERFECT THING
results.tagline: You came for the bread and you're not sorry
results.blurb: You would rather have one extraordinary thing than eleven average ones, and you have never once been swayed by quantity. Your plate is small, your standards are unreasonable, and you are usually right. Other people queue for the tower. You wait for the bread.
strengths: Finds the best thing in the room
results.watchOut: You'll miss something great because it was next to something average. Look sideways.

results.name: THE PLATE FILLER
results.tagline: Yours is cold because you were getting theirs
results.blurb: You have never once been first at a buffet. You are the person who finds out what everyone wants, carries four plates, remembers who doesn't eat mushrooms and notices when somebody's glass is empty. Your own dinner is lukewarm. You would do it again tomorrow.
results.watchOut: Eat something hot, sitting down, at least once this month.

results.name: THE SAUCE PERSON
results.tagline: It's not a meal without something poured on it
results.blurb: You believe food is a delivery mechanism for sauce and you have been vindicated repeatedly. You ask for extra on the side. You have opinions about viscosity. You have, on at least one occasion, been the person who brought their own hot sauce to a buffet, and you were right to.
results.watchOut: Not everything needs improving. Taste it before you drown it.

results.name: THE RETURNER
results.blurb: You have a route. You have timings. The first plate is reconnaissance, the second is serious, the third is the one you don't tell people about, and the fourth is technically pudding. The buffet is not a meal to you. It is a sport, and you are winning it politely.
results.watchOut: You'll keep going back for more when you already have enough. Sit down with plate two.
